warm-canvas.$description: Warm Canvas — Page background — a warm off-white that gives the entire site its paper-like quality

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, and product-screenshot backgrounds

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Secondary surface for subtle differentiation — post bodies, sidebar items, input fields

soft-fog.$description: Soft Fog — Tertiary surface for nested elements, dividers, and inactive states

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icons, and headings — near-black warmth rather than pure black

steel.$description: Steel — Tertiary text, timestamps, and helper labels

silver.$description: Silver — Muted text, placeholders, and inactive icon fills

charcoal-card.$description: Charcoal Card — Dark-mode product card surface shown in feature sections

resolve-green.$description: Resolve Green — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

highlight-wash.$description: Highlight Wash — Soft warm-yellow background for highlighted callouts and quote blocks

sienna-brand.$description: Sienna Brand — Decorative branding — paint-splash illustrations and brand-icon accents that frame content edges

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

inter.$description: Sole typeface for all UI, headings, body, and buttons. The 58px hero headline with weight 600 and -0.031em tracking is the typographic anchor — tight, confident, never thin. Body text settles at 14–16px with weight 400. No display serif or alternate families — the system achieves hierarchy purely through size and weight within Inter.

ui-monospace.$description: ui-monospace — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

emoji.$description: emoji — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
